interpretation: Diagnostic comparison only. relief3x is a project source representation, not independent ground truth; no terrain edits, defect labels, or acceptance thresholds follow from these deltas.

formula.per_axis: prom_d = max(0, H[row,col] - max(H[row-d,col], H[row+d,col])) for NS; analogously columns for EW
formula.positive_support: strictly > 0, for same axis and same distance on both grids
formula.difference: B prominence minus relief3x prominence; no new tolerance

support_bit_map.common: B and relief3x both have positive prominence at same node/axis/scale
support_bit_map.B_only: B positive and relief3x not positive at same node/axis/scale
support_bit_map.relief3x_only: relief3x positive and B not positive at same node/axis/scale

classification_limit: Positive support is a formula-level descriptor. Same-node B/source agreement does not prove feature identity, naturalness, source correctness, or visual quality; disagreement is not automatically an artifact.
